subject.title: [Feature]: Cron page automation-ideas gallery and Create & run now in quick-create

question: Should immediate first-run behavior be added to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104251, or tracked as a narrow follow-up while that PR owns starter suggestions?
rationale: The active redesign clearly supersedes the proposed gallery placement and quick-create structure, but it does not clearly implement the distinct immediate execution behavior.

options.title: Add it to redesign
options.body: Extend the active redesign with separate create-only and create-and-run actions using a clean created-job result.

options.title: Split immediate run
options.body: Let the redesign land suggestions and retain this issue only for a focused add-then-run follow-up.

options.title: Defer immediate run
options.body: Land the redesign without immediate execution and keep scheduled-first behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Add it to redesign
recommendation.body: Extend the active redesign with separate create-only and create-and-run actions using a clean created-job result.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns this proposal, the overlapping product direction, and the active implementation PR.
